title: What If a Major City's Taps Ran Dry? Cape Town Almost Did

scenes.text: What if a major city's taps ran dry? In 2018, Cape Town came within weeks of it.
Its biggest dam fell below ten percent. Officials named the date: Day Zero, April 12.
After Day Zero, taps would shut, and people would queue at collection points for 25 liters a day.
The daily allowance had already been cut from 87 liters to 50.
Residents cut their use hard. Restrictions saved more than 62 million liters a day.
Day Zero was pushed back, then scrapped as the dams recovered. A whole city changed its habits.

description:
